sigma_rules.title: LSA PPL Protection Setting Modification via CommandLine
sigma_rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

analytics.name: Analytic 0995
analytics.guidance: Detection of processes launching downgraded PowerShell versions (e.g., v2) or other legacy binaries that lack logging or security features. Correlates command-line arguments, process metadata, and version fields. Monitors registry changes to Defender or HVCI keys that could indicate intentional downgrades.

tuning.description: Defines which versions of interpreters like PowerShell are permitted in the environment.
Specific registry paths for monitoring Defender/HVCI configurations that may vary by Windows version.

analytics.name: Analytic 0996
analytics.guidance: Monitors execution of older or legacy interpreters (e.g., python2, bash with restricted history logging), downgrade of TLS/SSL configurations, or forced fallback to unencrypted protocols. Detects suspicious reconfiguration of kernel modules or boot loaders to reduce integrity controls.

tuning.description: List of TLS/SSL versions approved for use; alerts triggered if older protocols (e.g., TLS 1.0) are used.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of downgraded interpreters such as python2 or forced fallback commands

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Kernel or daemon warnings of downgraded TLS or cryptographic settings

analytics.name: Analytic 0997
analytics.guidance: Detection of execution of legacy scripting runtimes (e.g., older versions of Python, Bash, or PowerShell Core) lacking auditing. Monitoring for changes to EFI or system boot files indicative of downgrade-based persistence or bypass of integrity features.

tuning.description: Defines the minimal version of interpreters expected; older versions flagged as downgrade attempts.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Execution of older or non-standard interpreters

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Modifications or writes to EFI system partition for downgraded bootloaders
